newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian peso forges higher to end at 1,008.20.
newsitem.headline: Colombian peso forges higher to end at 1,008.20.

text.p: Colombia's peso ended 2.4 higher at 1,008.20 in active trade on the country's interbank market, which one dealer described as "flooded" by an oversupply of dollars.
It was the peso's fourth consecutive close higher and the highest since January 11, shortly after the newly buoyant local currency breeched the 1,000-to-one barrier for the first time ever.
"The market is flooded by dollars and there isn't enough demand to push the (dollar exchange) rate higher," one dealer said in the telephone interview.
He and others said dollar-selling by oil exporters and the corporate sector supported the peso throughout Monday's session.
Trading was active, with $148.5 million in currency changing hands, and dealers said the peso held in a 1,008 to 1,012.85 range.
